notes: Branch 1 as written stops at Shu'ba; the names after «قالا» (Muhammad b. Ja'far, Shu'ba, Mansur, Rabi'i, Ali) are written once for the second branch, so whether they also end the first branch is not settled by the text
«ابن، بشار» keeps the comma of the text; the attached و is left out
«- رضى الله عنه -» and «يخطب» are not part of the surface; the Prophet is not a link
